title: elytrigia repens var. pubescens
intro: Elytrigia repens var. pubescens, commonly known as Dune Brome, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include the potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties that may aid in reducing swelling and pain. The therapeutic actions of Dune Brome are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which can help to improve circulation and reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Dune Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
